    Class TpLogigram

    Solves logic-grid puzzles by matching items across categories using written clues.

    Example

    <tp-logigram label="The reading club">
      <dl>
        <dt>Prompt</dt>
        <dd><p>Three readers chose different books and drinks. Find every match.</p></dd>
        <dt>Categories</dt>
        <dd>
      <ul>
        <li>Readers<ul><li>Ada</li><li>Ben</li><li>Cleo</li></ul></li>
        <li>Books<ul><li>Poetry</li><li>History</li><li>Science</li></ul></li>
        <li>Drinks<ul><li>Tea</li><li>Juice</li><li>Water</li></ul></li>
      </ul>
      </dd>
        <dt>Clues</dt>
        <dd>
      <ol>
        <li>Ada chose Poetry.</li>
        <li>The History reader drank Juice.</li>
        <li>Ben drank Water.</li>
        <li>Cleo did not choose Poetry.</li>
      </ol>
      </dd>
        <dt>Solution</dt>
        <dd>
      <ol>
        <li><ul><li>Ada</li><li>Poetry</li><li>Tea</li></ul></li>
        <li><ul><li>Ben</li><li>Science</li><li>Water</li></ul></li>
        <li><ul><li>Cleo</li><li>History</li><li>Juice</li></ul></li>
      </ol>
    </dd>
      </dl>
    </tp-logigram>

    Tagname

    tp-logigram

    Attr

    label = "Logigram" - Puzzle title.

    Attr

    src = "" - Markdown file containing Prompt, Categories, Clues and Solution definitions.

    Attr

    auto-exclude = false - Marks other cells in the same pair row and column as no after a yes.

    Attr

    disabled = false - Prevents playing and using game controls. tp-logigram-change Emitted after a move, undo, redo or reset.

    Eventdetail

    tp-logigram-change { value: number[] } tp-logigram-check Emitted after checking the grid.

    Eventdetail

    tp-logigram-check { correct: number; total: number; errors: number[]; complete: boolean }

    Keyboard

    Cycles the focused cell through unknown, no and yes, or activates a control.

    Keyboard

    Moves between cells in the same category pair.

    Keyboard

    Clears the focused cell.
